Author: Malodorous Fang
Name: Fang's Venue Greeter
Punchline: Schedule based automated venue greeter/shouter for venues with multiple performers.
Description: Auto-greets guests and runs timed shouts for scheduled performers. Never double-greets returning visitors, and a built-in buffer keeps you under the spam filter so groups are all greeted. Timed shouts use a customizable playlist with the same Name/Link variables as greetings.
